name: compose-sensitive-host-path-mount
task_triggers: adding a bind mount to a service
mounting a host directory into a container
attack_scenario: Mounting /etc:/host-etc lets the container overwrite /etc/shadow or /etc/sudoers to add a backdoor account; mounting /var/lib/docker exposes all other containers' layers and secrets.
negative_test_hint: add a volume mount of "/:/host" to the compose service and assert it is rejected, mounting only an app-scoped subdirectory

exemplar.explanation: Bind-mounting the host root or a whole sensitive directory (/etc, /proc, /sys, /root, /boot, /dev, /var/lib/docker) gives the container read/write access to host credentials, kernel interfaces, and every other container's data — a straight container-escape path. Mounting only an app-scoped host subdirectory confines what a compromised container can reach.
